digest.component_or_area: rebar-implement skill and shared test-design documentation
propositions: Parity census in SKILL.md §4a must enumerate five parallel surfaces (CLI, MCP-API, library-facade, automated-callers, dual-direction) and disposition each as in-scope-proven or out-of-scope-with-reason.
Config-effect contrast tests in test-design.md §6 must prove that each config key changes behavior through the real read path, not merely that it is parsed.

Contention triggers in SKILL.md §4b must route three case-c shapes (composed/check-then-act writes, write-storm/retry-reclamation, read-integrity-under-contention) to existing shared suites without creating bespoke harnesses.
Behavioral gate findings must have a RED test added first in the same change before the fix is applied; non-behavioral findings may be fixed directly.
Phase-5 residual-gap sweep must enumerate and disposition all items from census out-of-scope slots, exclusions, compromises, and deferred advisories as filed, accepted-with-reason, or fixed.
